We're doing a callback now?|audio = TheFinalActWave30-2.ogg|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 30 ([[The Narratorium]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Narrator''' was the final boss [[The Final Act Event]]. It had far higher health than the [[Producer]] but walks slightly slower than it. As it was a [[Boss]] enemy in the event, most stalls were either weaker or did not work on it at all. The '''Narrator''' has five abilities: #''Hand Laser'', which fires ten thin laser beams from the fingertips of both hands. These apply a 25% [[Fatigue Debuff]] and [[Scared Debuff]] which last 22.5 seconds. # ''Hand Slam'', where both hands raise up and curl into fists, then slam the ground stunning towers for 6 seconds and dealing 75,000 damage to units in 12.5 radius. #''Hand Summon'', which the '''Narrator''' spawns three [[MiniHand]]s with a 1.5 second delay between each one. #''Boss Base Attack'', the '''Narrator''' becomes immune to all damage and twirls its wand, summoning an orange fireball that spins around the '''Narrator''' for a few seconds. When the fireball reaches the tip of his wand, it uses it to strike the base and dealing damage equal to 40% of the max base health, accounting for the max possible [[Medic]] overheal but not the [[Skills]] overheal. This can be stopped with the four [[Spotlight]]s aimed at '''Narrator''', which if done right should make the '''Narrator''' get highlighted. #''Dichromatic Crossfire'', a rage mode ability that happens at half health. In it, both hands' index and middle fingers fire a purple and an orange infernal beam separately, which rotate in random directions for 3 seconds. The '''Narrator''' also temporarily gains the [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute. ==Logbook Description== "''The Narrator is a performer from the Old World who used to be the right-hand man of Lord Exo. After being used for his revival, he achieved his theatrical moment on stage, striking a deal with Commander. He relies on his hands Righty and Lefty who were empowered by Lord Exo, making them some of the most powerful entities in existence.''" ==Appearance== The '''Narrator''' has a dark grey body with stubby-legs from the belowknee down, and a white half-mask face, having a golden-like cut on the cheek of said mask, and having a crescent moonlike shape that curves upwards that is a reddish pink. And to add to its legs, it has two edges at its ankles that look like undefined small wings. Has no mouth on the other side of its halfmasked face, but it has a sharp white mouth a fourpointed star acting as its eye there too. The '''Narrator''' also wears a dark velvet suit with gold accents, with gold buttons and a dark red jabot with a golden star, having a dark velvet top hat with red feathers and two golden lines, one on the brim of its hat, and another one on the top. It has golden shoulder-pad epaulettes, having a jacket with flared out collars, the edge of said collars having gold too, with a gold line on each wristband of the jacket, also having ruffled ends at the very end of each wrist. It has a tail coat connected to his jacket, which has golden edges. It also has white gloves. It carries a magician stick with its right hand. Behind it, it has two giant floating hands named [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]]. These are giant disembodied human hands wearing a white glove. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, like the [[Ranger]], [[Turret]], [[Accelerator]], [[Warlock]] or [[Golden Minigunner]]. **The [[Ranger]] is especially useful, as they have map-wide range and immunity to the stuns from the '''Narrator's''' attacks. ***The [[Medic]] can also be used to shield normally not stun immune towers from these attacks. **The [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can be used to boost the statistics of these towers. *The '''Narrator''' can damage the base health with its ''Boss Base Attack'' ability, dealing 40% of the max base health as damage. **To stop this, players need to redirect all the [[Spotlight]]s so that they point at the '''Narrator'''. ***You can target multiple [[Spotlight]]s at once; doing so is easier than targeting one [[Spotlight]] at a time. ***The '''Narrator''' will gain a yellow outline if all of the [[Spotlight]]s are successfully redirected to him, allowing player to know they succeeded stopped him from using this ability. **Due to the base damage being 40%, this means you can under most circumstances miss stopping the ability twice. ***It is not possible to survive for longer with the help of the [[Medic]], as the ability accounts for its overheal. ***The ability does not increase how much damage it deals when the players has overheal from [[Skills]], meaning that in Easy mode, it is possible to increase how many hits you can take before dying. *The '''Narrator''' can summon in multiple [[MiniHand]]s on the path, however, these are not meant to kill the player under most circumstances. **They can only kill if spawned directly at the exit. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNarrator.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TheFinalActPromoImage.png|'''Narrator''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} TheFinalAct9Hour.png|'''Narrator''' on the game icon. CardboardNarrator.png|Cardboard cutout of the '''Narrator'''. }} ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- |[[File:AlertSound.ogg]] |Alert Sound |} }}}} ==Trivia== *The '''Narrator's''' boss theme, [https://youtu.be/oiHDfFVIqt8?si=rwBweU-6SrBGzIyj In Bright Lights], samples lyrics from ''The Mind Electric'', a song by ''Tally Hall'' / ''Miracle Musical''. *The '''Narrator''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. *The '''Narrator''' appears in the asymmetrical horror game ''FORSAKEN'' as a skin for the killer [[w:c:forsaken2024:Noli|Noli]] in which it can be obtained by beating [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Narrator''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Narrator's''' model does not turn into a hologram properly when converted by [[Hacker]]. **{{Bug}} '''Narrator''' still uses its abilities whenever converted by [[Hacker]]. **{{Bug}} ''Boss Base Attack'' will automatically stun the '''Narrator''' on any map that does not have the [[Spotlight]]. **{{Bug}} '''Narrator's''' hands do not have any animations in the [[Index]]. *'''11 February 2026''' - [[v1.85.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Narrator's''' model is invisible. *'''16 February 2026''' - [[v1.85.0|v1.85.2]] **{{Bugfix}} Model is now visible. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Narrator''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''8 May 2026''' - [[v1.90.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Narrator's''' model is invisible. *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Model is now visible. ==Notes== {{TheNarratorium|[[Painter]]|Wave 28|Narrator|Wave 30|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Narrator}} [[Category:Bosses]]
